text: These applications propose to revitalize the existing Toronto Community Housing Corporation's (TCHC) lands to permit four residential buildings with heights of four to 25 storeys, two mixed-use buildings of 25 storeys, a community hub, and a public park at 3 Marsh Grassway, 7 and 11 Blue Grassway, 1, 2 and 8 Dune Grassway, 4 and 17 Cane Grassway, and 5, 10 and 40 Turf Grassway. The existing 12-storey apartment building at 5 Needle Firway and the two rows of two-storey townhouses at 2-14 and 22-36 Needle Firway form part of this application and are to be retained. Collectively, the subject site is called the Firgrove Grassways community.
